name: Alphalete - Sitemap Fix 2026-07-08
body:
> Audit · Alphalete · 2026-07-08

# Summary
A working folder scoped only to the GSC sitemap error and unindexed pages. Its README is a dated findings log from July 8 2026. It found the root cause of the sitemap error (the Search Atlas MetaSync plugin hijacking `/sitemap_index.xml`), fixed it, then pushed Tier 1 and Tier 2 city page content. Later decisions changed the platform again (see Status).

# Key findings and actions (Jul 8)
- **Yoast to Rank Math switch:** Rank Math v1.0.273 active, Yoast inactive. The Yoast import was incomplete: 84 published (thin, outlying) city pages lost custom titles and descriptions, and noindex settings did not migrate.
- **Restore + noindex:** copied Yoast title, meta and focus keyword into Rank Math for the 84 gap pages and set them noindex. Full `wp_postmeta` dump backed up first.
- **Root cause of the sitemap error:** MetaSync (`metasync` v2.6.15) registered a rewrite rule for `/sitemap_index.xml` ahead of Rank Math and served a broken index listing only the homepage. LiteSpeed had masked it with a 7-day-old good copy. MetaSync injects its rules at read time, so flushing did not remove them.
- **Fix:** cleared MetaSync's virtual sitemap options and added mu-plugin `zzz-rankmath-owns-sitemap.php` (v1.1.0) that strips any `metasync_sitemap=` rule. Verified live: post-sitemap 29 URLs, page-sitemap 153, category 1.
- **Reversed the noindex** later the same day on Kim's decision: the 84 town pages set back to index (against the recommendation that they are thin doorway pages). Sitemap then listed 237 indexable pages.

# Tier 1 and Tier 2 content push
- `Alphalete Tier 1 Page Drafts.docx`: 12 drafts (Colorado Springs, Denver, Woodland Park x drain, hydro, camera, commercial pipelining), see [Alphalete - Tier 1 Page Drafts 2026-07-08](lib:brain-alphalete-tier-1-page-drafts-2026-07-08).
- Tier 1: SEO meta live on all 12; body replaced on 8. Drain and hydro WP pages with strong hyper-local content kept as-is.
- Tier 2 (9 towns, 36 pages): meta live on all; body replaced on 28 standard-template pages; 8 custom pages kept.
- Flags raised: site-wide footer claimed "20-year warranty, built to last 50+ years"; the CS camera page lost real neighborhood names.

# Status (later changes)
- Rank Math and Yoast were later uninstalled; MetaSync/OTTO became the only SEO head (Jul 31) and now serves the sitemap. See [Alphalete - Decisions and Rules](lib:brain-alphalete-decisions-and-rules).
- City pages moved to root slugs in August.

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `README.md`: the findings log summarized above.
- `Alphalete Tier 1 Page Drafts.docx`: 12-page draft set with keyword map.
- `Alphalete-Town-Pages.xlsx`: all 176 town pages with ad-informed priority tiers, focus keyword, meta, population estimate and the 84 re-index batch flag.
- `Real Photo from clients\`: 130 client job photos (webp); a few (002, 030, 060, 070) were vetted as privacy-clean.
